[![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.82901%2Fnemar.nm000475-blue)](https://doi.org/10.82901/nemar.nm000475)

# s500-generic-44: Crossmodal face-name person-identity frequency tagging, SEEG of the left ventral temporal cortex (Volfart et al., 2020) (derivative)

SEEG (Experiment 2 of the article) from 7 patients with refractory epilepsy (University Hospital of Nancy) during crossmodal
frequency tagging: pictures of faces and written names of a famous identity at 4 Hz with another identity every 7th item
(0.571 Hz), plus face-only and name-only control conditions. The scalp-EEG experiments of the release (Experiment 1 and
Experiment 2, Biosemi 128, trial-averaged Letswave files) are NOT converted; their de-identified files are in sourcedata/.
NOTE: in the Dryad release (version 2) the SEEG .mat data files of participants ['P01', 'P02', 'P04', 'P05'] are EMPTY
MATLAB arrays (1960-byte files whose 'data' carries the MATLAB_empty flag; the .lw5 headers list the channels but
datasize has 0 sequences). Only the 3 participants with data (P03, P06, P07) are converted; the empty
files are kept in sourcedata/ as released.

THIS IS A DERIVATIVE DATASET: the release contains the authors' Letswave files, low-pass filtered at 30 Hz
(Butterworth order 4) and cut into sequences, not the raw Micromed recordings.

## Source
- Dryad: Angélique Volfart, Jacques Jonas, Louis Maillard, Sophie Colnat-Coulbois, Bruno Rossion. Data from: Neurophysiological evidence for crossmodal person-identity representation in the human left ventral temporal cortex. doi:10.5061/dryad.m8t391m (version 2, 2020-02-28). License: CC0 1.0 (Dryad record).
- Article: Volfart A, Jonas J, Maillard L, Colnat-Coulbois S, Rossion B (2020) Neurophysiological evidence for crossmodal (face-name) person-identity representation in the human left ventral temporal cortex. PLoS Biology 18(4):e3000659, doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3000659.
- Dryad files: FaceNameAssociation_Metadata.zip + README, verified against the Dryad md5 digests by the download lane.

## Contents
- `sub-<id>/ieeg/sub-<id>_task-<task>_run-1_ieeg.*`: 9 files, 3 participants, 0.32 h. Each file holds the
  sequences of one condition back-to-back (one BrainVision segment per sequence; `RecordingType` epoched, `EpochLength` =
  sequence length). Values are the release's float32 values, unchanged (MNE read-back matches). Sampling rate from the
  Letswave header. Tasks:
  - `task-facename`: FaceName: faces and names of one identity at 4 Hz, identity change every 7th item (0.571 Hz)
  - `task-faceonly`: FaceOnly: faces only, identity change every 7th item
  - `task-nameonly`: NameOnly: names only, identity change every 7th item
- Channels: labels from the Letswave header. Intracerebral contacts are typed SEEG; scalp electrodes recorded with the
  SEEG (labels `s<10-20 name>`) EEG; ECG, physiological monitors (MISC) and marker inputs (TRIG) as labelled. Unit µV is
  assumed (Letswave import of Micromed TRC; not stated in the release). The reference is not stated per participant.
- Electrode coordinates: each SEEG participant's folder has an xlsx table of Talairach coordinates (README: 'Talairach MNI space', used for display only; anatomical definitions were made on individual anatomy). They are written to `space-Talairach_electrodes.tsv` (3 participants). Contacts not present in the table have x/y/z n/a.
- `events.tsv`: the Letswave events (code, sequence, latency) of each file that has any (9 files have no Letswave
  events and no events.tsv); most frequent codes: [].
- Letswave history per file is in each `ieeg.json` (`SoftwareFilters`).
- `sourcedata/dryad-m8t391m-deidentified/`: the release's files, de-identified (below);
  `DEIDENTIFICATION_MANIFEST.tsv` lists original and new sha-256 per file.
- No stimuli are included in the release.

## Privacy
- Letswave event codes with a leading participant-code token were replaced by 'seq' in events.tsv and in the
  de-identified .lw5 headers (0 distinct tokens; a byte search of the whole output found
  0 remaining occurrences). Letswave history dates and MAT text-header dates in sourcedata are reduced to
  month and year (day -> 01). The .lw5 headers were rewritten with scipy (savemat, MATLAB v5, compressed); their content is
  otherwise unchanged.
- Age and sex are not given per participant in the release.
